Case for buying REV now, as the strongest honest version:

- Organic class with no airdrop dump seen, and the first two minutes after graduation drew 325 buyers (ex-agent) for about 309 SOL. That is broad, not a single operator's bundle.
- Top-5 buyer share is 15%, top-3 on the curve 21%, and bundle share 19%. Concentration is moderate, not extreme.
- Last 15 minutes: 705 buyers versus 402 sellers, 282 SOL bought against 237 sold, and net inflow of 45 SOL. Demand is still net positive into the current window.
- Price is up 184% over 30 minutes and is only 19% off its high. That is a pullback from a strong run, not a collapse.
- Depth of 185 SOL keeps a $20 ticket's impact small.

Caveats that cut against this: the 30-minute window is short, sell-to-buy in the first two minutes was 0.74, and a 19% drawdown after an 184% run is where many coins keep falling. Only about 4% of buy volume in the last 15 minutes was net, so momentum is thin. Nothing here shows demand will hold for 30-60 more minutes. The honest read is a weak case; skipping is defensible.

The 19% drawdown from the 30-minute high shows the top is already rolling over. At a $20 ticket, a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost plus a fast 30-second fill means a further 10-20% dip erases any gain. Skip.
